setup.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -sSfL https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init -o /tmp/rustup-init
  chmod +x /tmp/rustup-init
  /tmp/rustup-init -y --profile minimal --default-toolchain stable --no-modify-path
  export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
fi
rustup component add rustfmt clippy
python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --quiet pyyaml
command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs

run.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
cargo build
ASTERLANE_CONFIG=examples/gateway.yaml ASTERLANE_ADMIN_TOKEN=demo-admin-token-2026 EXA_DEFAULT=replace-me-exa-key exec cargo run -- serve --bind 127.0.0.1:3000 --database-url 'sqlite:///tmp/asterlane-preview.db?mode=rwc'
